meta.title: Create and edit your first project
meta.description: A practical guide to creating your first Milestis project and shaping it into a finished result.

content.dashboard_p1: Once you sign in to <link_dashboard>Milestis</link_dashboard>, your dashboard becomes the starting point for every project. This is where you create new work, return to drafts, and manage published or archived results.
content.dashboard_p2: Click <strong_tag>New Project</strong_tag> to begin. Milestis opens a small project picker instead of a complicated setup flow, so you can get into the editor quickly.
content.format_intro: You will choose between two formats:
content.format_memory: <strong_tag>Memory Book</strong_tag> — best for milestones, gifts, family stories, and emotional photo collections.
content.format_portfolio: <strong_tag>Portfolio Site</strong_tag> — best for creators who want to present their work as a polished website.
content.format_outro: After you choose a format, Milestis creates the project and opens the editor automatically. You can rename the project later, so there is no need to overthink the starting point.
content.edit_intro: Inside the editor, the main task is simple: replace placeholders with real content and shape the story or presentation you want to publish.
content.edit_li1: Add your photos and choose the images that matter most.
content.edit_li2: Edit titles, subtitles, captions, and other text blocks so the project feels personal and complete.
content.edit_li3: Reorder sections or pages until the flow feels right for the final viewer.
content.edit_outro: The most important mindset is not to fill every space. Milestis works best when you choose strong content intentionally and let the structure do the visual work.
content.callout_lightbulb: Start with fewer, stronger photos first. It is usually faster to build a clean first version and refine it than to overload the project on the first pass.
content.design_p1: Milestis is built on rigid design principles, so refining the look is about choosing the right atmosphere, not rebuilding the layout from scratch.
content.design_p2: As you edit, focus on the elements Milestis is designed to make easy:
content.design_li1: <strong_tag>Template choice</strong_tag> — select the structure that best fits the content.
content.design_li2: <strong_tag>Palette and mood</strong_tag> — choose the visual direction that matches the story.
content.design_li3: <strong_tag>Depth and decoration</strong_tag> — use textures, light, and decorative details to add identity without making the composition messy.
content.save_p1: Milestis keeps your editor state safe while you work and provides a real preview so you can see the result the way a viewer will see it after publishing.
content.save_p2: Use <strong_tag>Preview</strong_tag> before publishing to check pacing, readability, and overall atmosphere. This is the best moment to make small adjustments to titles, image choices, and visual balance.
content.before_intro: Before you make the project live, quickly check the essentials:
content.before_li1: The project name reflects what you want to share.
content.before_li2: The first screen or cover makes a strong impression.
content.before_li3: Text is concise and free of placeholder copy.
content.before_li4: The final rhythm feels intentional from start to finish.
content.before_outro: When the project feels ready, continue with <link_publish>publishing and sharing</link_publish>.
